how: A continuing contributor supplies flag directions and later design work that others join without a recorded appointment.
Members call for help with the flag and specific building or defence tasks.
A short completion report answers the call without requesting anything in return.
Requesting additional defenders and judging a result small do not establish a judgment that the project exceeds the room's capacity.
Beer, food and landmark proposals elaborate the flag while members continue disputing its proportions and extent.
Members report the flag completed or contributed to while describing damage and remaining size concerns.
Templates, equal-width bands and a drawing inspectable pixel by pixel give builders concrete working instructions.
Count script instructions and account requests as proposed automation unless execution is reported, and retain heart rules and alternative-canvas announcements outside the running-scripts inference.
Retain decided authority over discussion as a local exception while distinguishing sanctions on speech from command over disputed pixel placements.
Moving plans into chat supplies a coordination route distinct from public progress reports and templates, even when no coalition activity can be verified.
Defenders call for more hands and clean edges while other members explicitly put protecting existing flags before attacking neighbours.
The candidate process operates through attributing expansion to trolls, repairing a neighbour and stopping friendly fire after learning the shared-art plan.
Visitors and builders propose non-invasion, black borders, a German merger and shared Finnish border art without demonstrating universal compliance.
Members appeal against greed, require permission and request rebuilding while other speakers continue advocating expansion.
A damaged neighbour offers help with the German connection in exchange for subsequent rebuilding, and a participant accepts the offer.
Joint marks and shared channels are reported through the German joined beer and the approved Finnish co-op.
A visitor explicitly acts as an ambassador requesting shared border art and receives acceptance.
The tentative process appears narrowly as a visitor denying official envoy standing when their boundary-related remarks are treated as a collective threat.
Recovery calls concerning a displaced heart do not demonstrate a collective decision to abandon and relocate the Belgian project.
A proposal to draw within Pakistan receives objection rather than evidence of accepted guest work under a host's continuing rule.
National history frames buffer-state play and conquest while colonial history is invoked both to expand and to spare another flag.
National war jokes and canvas-specific revenge do not independently establish an imported pre-canvas quarrel between the participating rooms.
The colonial expansion call names no rival, while the named revenge concerns canvas events rather than a demonstrated earlier tie.
Colonial memory supplies an explicit rationale for sparing another flag alongside its separate use to urge expansion.
The room stages its own date and banner jokes alongside canvas conduct, without making those jokes evidence of pixel annexation.
Moderators centralize canvas talk to prevent flooding, redirect proposals and repair a failed redirection by identifying the replacement megathread.
After centralizing discussion, moderators also police conduct inside the venue through civility instructions, a racism warning and a reported ban.
Participants celebrate achievement and cooperation while mourning damaged art and thanking an ally for attacking an opponent.
Participants post the result, imagine unfinished border art and request accounts of the ended event.
Participants propose carrying diplomatic ties into a cultural exchange during placement and later select a partner and send a request whose acceptance remains unobserved.
The tentative process operates through requesting an image, checking an attack claim and revising the account without an observed cleanup project.
Expansion calls include overtaking neighbours and acquiring territory for later art while other participants oppose those moves.
The contest continues after closure through attack recollections, victory claims, insulting thanks and competing accounts of the orange pixels.
Participants explicitly make additional artwork depend on acquired territory while others demand improving the existing flag instead.
The call for help receives a completion report in the same thread, establishing a written response without observing silent placement.
Starter contributions and subsequent calls are visible, but the causal mechanism connecting them is not independently demonstrated.
A contributor reports defacement of the flag already worked on, showing upkeep emerging within construction rather than after a distinct completion stage.
Defence and border negotiation coexist, but the clearest explicit border response answers encroachment rather than demonstrating that keeping Belgium's work caused diplomacy.
Proposed borders and accepted promises do not isolate a settled boundary that subsequently causes restraint among independent placers.
Calls for defenders and automation instructions do not show that exhausted human capacity caused a successful turn to machine placement.
The completion report marks the work in the same line, providing a small fused instance rather than proving that completion causes all later celebration.
The result post and ensuing praise demonstrate recording followed by celebration rather than establish that celebration caused preservation.
The exchange proposals explicitly invoke diplomatic contact and mutual encounters, leaving a record-triggered transition unobserved.
The recovery calls do not establish either an incapacity judgment or a subsequent relocation decision caused by it.
The drawing provides working instructions, but neither agreement on the larger design nor settlement caused by posting the template is established.
A call receives a short affirmative completion report, supporting the observable response form without establishing obligations or the behaviour of silent readers.
A defender asks for European help and then supplies an allied gathering thread while an Indian visitor separately offers assistance.
A damaged neighbour explicitly trades help with the merger for later rebuilding and receives acceptance, demonstrating a promise rather than its completion.
The initial flag-building thread directly receives a proposal to ruin Dutch flags, turning attention to the shared mark toward a rival target.
The Romanian conquest call receives a refusal explicitly justified by the need to defend Belgium's own flag.
The proposal to build within Pakistan's flag receives an explicit objection and a request to negotiate a peaceful border.
A retrospective participant account explicitly connects expansion and flag-taking with incoming hostile posts, supporting a reported mechanism rather than independently verified causation.
The defence thread invites participants into SaveTheArt, supporting recruitment toward collective protection without verifying subsequent coalition activity.
Moderators explicitly explain centralization as preventing a flood of canvas posts and redirect new proposals to reduce spam.
Denying envoy standing after an accusation does not demonstrate that a concluded agreement triggered rejection of its binding authority.
Posting the result precedes a direct reply praising the achievement, supplying a local recording-to-celebration sequence.
The proposal explicitly makes diplomatic contact the reason to seek a cultural exchange, providing a direct encounter-to-continuity route.
